title.zh: 宣布每年6月18日为本科特省特别非工作日公共假日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring June Eighteen of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Province of Benguet
title.orig: An Act Declaring June Eighteen of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Province of Benguet

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

text.en: The Province of Benguet was created by virtue of Republic Act No. 4695 which was enacted into law on June 18, 1966.
It is hereby declared that June Eighteen of every year be a nonworking public holiday in the Province of Benguet.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
